To drive further progress, we are working to achieve three additional  
sustainable packaging targets. The first is to ensure that 95% of the 
materials used in our new product packaging designs, by weight, will 
be recyclable or reusable by 2025. As of the end of 2023, we were 
exceeding this goal, at 97%. The second is to ensure that 100% of the 
virgin wood fiber used in our corrugated fiberboard packaging will be 
from a certified, responsibly managed source by 2025. We are well on 
track to reaching this target ahead of schedule. Third, we are focused on
